english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for foolishness expressed as an impractical course of action or a thoughtless act.

examples.english: Don't commit this kind of folly again—you left the whole family homeless just to save a little money.
examples.traditional: 你唔好再做呢啲蠢事喇，為咗慳少少錢搞到成家人冇地方住。
